close_reason: DnsLookupFailed message has no prefix; Display impl adds it
description: mta_sts_dns.rs line 32: MtaStsError::DnsLookupFailed is constructed with the string "DNS lookup failed: {e}". The Display impl for DnsLookupFailed formats as "MTA-STS: DNS lookup failed: {msg}", so the final output is "MTA-STS: DNS lookup failed: DNS lookup failed: <error>". The inner string should be just "{e}" — the Display prefix already supplies the context.
title: DnsLookupFailed message prefix duplicates Display prefix
